scope: same VCTK corpus, 10 previously unused speakers, 20 utterances, 16 fixed crop offsets
q: fraction of received samples with positive detection output >0.5
margin: mean over bits of abs(mean over received time of bit logit)
selection: maximum q or margin, tie chooses minimum p
r0: one second removed, NOT unedited input
exploratory: bit-output analysis, margin gating, attribution formula and conditional search are posthoc
availability: selected rows are included; original inference scripts, all candidates, exact source snapshot, preprocessing manifest and checkpoint hashes still require transfer from the research server
